verdict.rationale: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework, and its tooling ecosystem could plausibly ship built-in AI insights, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows the product itself generating insights or suggestions from a user's data. LLM-driven nodes, memory stores and LangSmith tracing are developer building blocks for constructing such a feature, not the feature itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
